definitions.explanation: A formal ceremony celebrating a marriage, encompassing the ritual and celebratory aspects.

examples.japanese: {婚礼|こんれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{儀|ぎ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
⟦{伝統的|でんとうてき}→伝統的：04802_dentouteki⟧な{婚礼|こんれい}⟦{衣装|いしょう}→衣装：14102_ishou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧まとった。

⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{婚礼|こんれい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{厳|おごそ}か→厳か：11864_ogosoka⟧な⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{執|と}り{行|おこな}われた→執り行う：19902_toriokonau⟧。
examples.english: The wedding at the shrine was conducted in a solemn atmosphere.

notes:
A formal, somewhat literary word for a wedding ceremony. While ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧ is the everyday term, {婚礼|こんれい} carries a more traditional and ceremonial tone. It is commonly seen in formal writing, historical contexts, and descriptions of traditional Japanese or Western-style weddings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {婚礼|こんれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{儀|ぎ}: wedding rites
- {婚礼|こんれい}⟦{衣装|いしょう}→衣装：14102_ishou⟧: wedding attire
- {婚礼|こんれい}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: wedding feast
- {婚礼|こんれい}⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧: wedding trousseau

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧: wedding ceremony — the standard everyday term
- {挙式|きょしき}: holding a wedding ceremony — focuses on the act of conducting the ceremony
- {祝言|しゅうげん}: wedding celebration — an older, more literary term
